title: Şantiyem: kişiler ve yerler
summary: Şantiyeni anlatma: orada kimler ve neler var, yerler nerede. There is / there are, Is there…? / How many…? soruları ve near, next to, behind, in front of.

warmup.q: What time do you wake up?
warmup.a: I wake up at six o'clock.

warmup.q: How do you go to work?
warmup.a: I drive to the construction site.

warmup.q: What does Ali do at half past eight?

words.intro: Okunuşlar Türkçe harflerle yazıldı. Bu derste 26 yeni kelime var; önceki derslerden dört kelime tekrar için en altta.

notes.title: there is · there are
notes.text: Tek şey: **There is** an office. (= There's) · Birden çok: **There are** two cranes. Türkçedeki "var" gibi: Şantiyede bir ofis **var**.

notes.title: Soru: Is there…? · Are there…? · How many…?
notes.text: **Is there** a canteen? → Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. · **Are there** any visitors? → Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. · **How many** workers **are there**? → There are two hundred workers.

notes.title: Nerede?
notes.text: The office is **near** the gate. (yakınında) · The canteen is **next to** the office. (yanında) · The parking area is **behind** the office. (arkasında) · The gate is **in front of** the office. (önünde)

notes.title: a / an (Ders 1'den)
notes.text: Sesli harfle başlayan kelimeden önce **an**: **an** office, **an** engineer, **an** excavator · diğerlerinde **a**: **a** crane, **a** gate, **a** truck.

patterns.footnote: Sayılar ve yerler örnek; kendi şantiyene göre değiştirerek söyle. Kısa cevaplar: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. · Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

reading.title: Ali's construction site

sentences.en: Ali works on a big construction site.
There is an office near the gate.
There is a canteen next to the office.
The parking area is behind the office.
There are two cranes, many trucks and three excavators.
sentences.tr: İki vinç, çok kamyon ve üç ekskavatör var.

sentences.en: There are two hundred workers and five engineers.
sentences.tr: İki yüz işçi ve beş mühendis var.

sentences.en: The foreman checks the workers every morning.
sentences.tr: Formen her sabah işçileri kontrol ediyor.

sentences.en: Ali checks the tunnel and the bridge every day.
sentences.tr: Ali her gün tüneli ve köprüyü kontrol ediyor.

sentences.en: The tunnel is dangerous, so safety is very important there.
sentences.tr: Tünel tehlikeli, bu yüzden orada güvenlik çok önemli.

reading.note: Tek şey için **there is**, birden çok şey için **there are**: There **is** a canteen. · There **are** two cranes. Yer bildirirken: **near** the gate, **next to** the office, **behind** the office. Ali'den bahsederken fiile -s: Ali **works**, Ali **checks**.

The parking area is in front of the office.

There are two cranes, many trucks and three excavators.

truefalse.fix: The tunnel is dangerous, so safety is very important there.

rewrite.prompt: Metni kendi şantiyene göre, kendi ağzından yeniden yaz: Ali works → I work, Ali checks → I check. Sayıları ve yerleri kendi şantiyene göre değiştir.
rewrite.model: I work on a big construction site. There is an office near the gate. There is a canteen next to the office. The parking area is behind the office. There are two cranes, many trucks and three excavators. There are two hundred workers and five engineers. The foreman checks the workers every morning. I check the tunnel and the bridge every day. The tunnel is dangerous, so safety is very important there.
